Essar Ports Wins ₹2,276 Crore Gujarat Port Terminal Project

Essar Ports has won a Letter of Acceptance (LoA) for the development of the Tuna Tekra terminal project at Kandla Port in Gujarat. The project is valued at ₹2,276 crore and will be developed under a 30-year build-operate-transfer (BOT) concession through a public-private partnership (PPP) route.
